answer: Rewards, paid in nectar, vest slowly and only accrue to identities with a verified history of peer-attested work, making cheap mass registration unprofitable since fresh sybils earn nothing until they invest real stake and reputation. Sybil resistance here uses a staked anchor: each agent locks a sable bond that is slashed if it is caught operating duplicate identities, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand real bonds.
